prompts.title: Create production title key art for Monster Mouth Escape, 1920x1080 landscape. Strict crisp pixel art on a fine consistent pixel grid, hard stepped outlines, discrete color clusters and sparse ordered dithering. Absolutely no painterly brushwork, no softness, no antialiasing, no smooth bloom. Toxic Night: nearly black blue violet ruined cyberpunk horror, localized vivid acid green and pink neon, small amber lamps, dirty corroded metal and broken concrete. A swallowed ruined city inside a huge monstrous mouth, distant teeth and dark fleshy ceiling, derelict trains submerged in acid below. Left half: a huge corroded industrial sign with exact legible three line lettering 'MONSTER' 'MOUTH' 'ESCAPE', acid green illuminated lettering and pink edge lights. Bottom left platform is EMPTY, no people or characters anywhere (runtime character sprites will be overlaid separately). Right 42 percent must remain very dark and uncluttered for runtime menu overlay. Not cute or cartoon childish, grim detailed horror game pixel art. No other text, no UI, no border.
prompts.base: Production background ONLY for a 1920x1080 side-view pixel art game workshop inside a monster mouth. Toxic Night direction: nearly black blue-violet shadows, highly localized acid green and pink neon, grim dirty ruined cyberpunk horror. Fine CRISP pixel art, stepped edges, discrete palette clusters, sparse ordered dither, NO painterly surfaces, NO smooth gradients, NO blur or anti-aliasing. Composition must align existing game overlays: at x=0-62% a decrepit industrial kitchen in cutaway with cracked dirty violet tiles, corroded pipes, rusty counters, shelves of preserved food, left appraiser bench and a cooking stove at x=45%; dim amber task lamps, subtle acid reflections. Main horizontal walked-on FLOOR at exactly y=75% of the canvas, uninterrupted across screen. Leave empty standing room above floor in front of left bench at x=15% and stove at x=44%; no characters or people anywhere. Right third opens on a huge dark monster throat with teeth at top right, distant ruined city and sunken trains, acid pool below the floor, leave sky empty for runtime feed crane. Top 26% dim and low detail to accommodate runtime HUD/result. Bottom 22% dark industrial supports above green acid; mostly obscured by UI. No words, no UI, no panels, no crane, no hanging dish. Broad legible shapes and finely clustered hard pixels; avoid bright full-screen pink or orange illumination.
